revision_notes: Province list rebuilt from settlement_assignments.json so renamed provinces and settlement memberships are authoritative.
Governments and moods preserved from belavados_provinces.json, matched to corrected province names.
El’dravire from the input province file is normalized to El'dravire Riverrealm from the assignments/time-zone sources.
Each province now includes primary UTC, display UTC labels, numeric UTC offsets, center longitude/latitude, and timezone notes.

conversion_formula: daysInEarthYear = 365, or 366 in a leap year
Belavadös clock time may use fractional part of belSolarDayProgress * 24
timekeeping.province_timezone_rule: Province summaries store primary UTC and one neighboring display UTC where useful; settlement-specific exports should store exact settlement UTC by longitude.
